review:
Devil's Crossroad splits its grid into four cross-shaped sections, each with four symbols joined by a central Devil Wild. Winning symbols are removed, and symbols next to the centre may randomly turn wild.

The Cross Multiplier removes matching symbols from the other sections whenever a win happens, raising the multiplier for each one it takes. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 13,180x cap. It's one of the studio's more experimental layouts, and worth a few demo spins to understand.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
